aboutUs.subtitle: We built FaceAuto with a clear goal: to bring total transparency, mathematical precision, and confidence to the automotive market.

mission.title: Real data instead of guesswork
mission.description: Buying a used car shouldn’t feel like a lottery. We analyze thousands of listings, market medians, mileages, and technical configurations to give every buyer and seller an objective, instant, and clear evaluation.

vision.title: End-to-end automotive market intelligence
vision.description: From our algorithmic deal scoring and instant price estimator to advanced anomaly risk detection, smart recommendations, and side-by-side car comparison — every tool is engineered to work seamlessly together.

aboutUs.teamTitle: Meet the people who built the platform

featuresPage.subtitle: Interactively explore every algorithm powering FaceAuto. Adjust the live sliders and scenarios to see exactly how we compute deal scores, anomaly risks, and price estimates.

scoring.title: Dynamic Valuation with per-10,000 km Depreciation & Progressive Tiers
scoring.description: Every listing starts at a neutral baseline of 50.0 points (on a 0–100 scale). The algorithm first filters P10–P90 price outliers, computes a mileage-adjusted Expected Price, and applies non-linear progressive tiers and anti-fraud caps.

points.groupingTitle: 3-Level Hierarchical Grouping (L1 → L2 → ±2 Year Sliding Window)
points.groupingDesc: L1 groups by brand, model, generation, year, engine_size, fuel_type, and gearbox (min. 5 cars). If fewer than 5 exist, it falls back to L2 (brand, model, generation, year), and for rare cars applies a ±2 year sliding window.
points.depreciationDesc: Baseline mileage is taken from cars within ±5% of the group median price, and the real €/10,000 km depreciation rate is derived from the price delta between low-mileage and high-mileage halves (or 5% of median fallback).
points.tiersDesc: When cheaper than Expected Price: +1.3 pts/% (0–10%), +1.0 pt/% (10–20%), +0.5 pts/% (20–30%), 0 pts plateau (30–35%, max +28 pts), and −2.0 pts/% beyond 35% discount. When overpriced: −1.0 pt/% (0–15%), −1.3 pts/% (15–25%), −1.6 pts/% (25–35%), and −2.0 pts/% (>35%).
points.penaltiesTitle: Suspicious Mileage, Taxi & Anti-Scam Hard Caps
points.penaltiesDesc: Mileage below (age × 6,000 km) or spam placeholders (111,111, 123,456, etc.): −15 pts (≤3 yrs) or −30 pts (>3 yrs). If also >20% cheaper than expected → capped at max 20.0 pts (Scam Cap). Mileage >45,000 km/yr (Taxi) → −20 pts. Damaged / salvage / missing papers → capped at max 10.0 pts.

scoring.damagedToggle: Damaged / salvage / parts / papers issue (Hard-cap max 10.0)

flags.clean: No penalties triggered — pure progressive price & mileage calculation

risk.title: Statistical Detection of Suspicious Listings
risk.description: Unlike Deal Scoring, Risk Analysis looks for statistical red flags using percentile distributions (P10, P25, P50 Median, P75, P90).

points.percentilesDesc: Measures exactly where asking price and mileage fall within the real database distribution.
points.overrideDesc: If price or mileage deviates by more than 45% from the median (with 25+ comparable cars), the anomaly score automatically escalates to 80–100.
points.specsDesc: Flags rare or unobserved combinations of engine, gearbox, drivetrain, or body style for that generation.

balanced.label: Balanced Offer
balanced.explanation: Asking price and mileage sit comfortably inside the central P25–P75 green zone, with a standard technical configuration.

cheapExtreme.label: Suspiciously Cheap (-52%)
cheapExtreme.explanation: Alert: Price falls below P10 and more than 45% below the median. The Extreme Override rule triggers (score 86/100) — high risk of hidden defects or scam.

mileageAnomaly.label: Unusual Mileage
mileageAnomaly.explanation: Price is normal, but the reported mileage is 64% below the median for cars of the same age — a clear signal to inspect the VIN history.

rareSpec.label: Atypical Configuration
rareSpec.explanation: The engine, gearbox, and drivetrain combination appears in fewer than 2% of observed listings — possible listing entry error.

estimator.title: Exponentially Weighted Percentiles (P20–P30, P40–P60, P70–P80)
estimator.description: The estimator selects deduplicated listings from the same brand, model, and generation (minimum 7 eligible cars) and interpolates continuous weighted percentiles.

points.minSupportDesc: Removes duplicates by technical fingerprint and verifies both pool size (≥7) and Effective Sample Size.
points.weightingDesc: Each comparable receives weight w = exp(−Δyear/3) × exp(−Δkm/100,000) × (0.95 + 0.05 × config_score).
points.bandsDesc: Quick Sale uses P20–P30, Normal Market Price uses P40–P60 (with P50 as market reference), and Higher Asking uses P70–P80.

fast.title: Quick Sale
fast.explanation: Weighted P20–P30 percentile band: positions the vehicle in the most competitive third of the market for fast liquidity.

normal.title: Normal Price
normal.explanation: Central P40–P60 percentile band around the P50 weighted median: reflects balanced market value for the car's year and mileage.

higher.title: Higher Asking
higher.explanation: Upper P70–P80 percentile band: suited for pristine condition, rare specifications, or negotiation headroom.

pipeline.title: All Tools Connected in One Seamless Workflow
pipeline.subtitle: Click each stage below to see how FaceAuto’s modules work together.

0.title: 1. Advanced Filtering by Brand, Model, Generation & Class
0.description: Browse thousands of cleaned and validated listings. Filter simultaneously by budget, year, mileage, engine size, horsepower, gearbox, drivetrain, and deal score.

1.title: 2. Similarity-Based Car Recommendation Engine
1.description: Found a car you like? Our recommendation engine automatically finds the closest alternatives matching vehicle class, price bracket, and mileage.

2.title: 3. Side-by-Side Comparison for Up to 3 Cars
2.description: Add up to 3 vehicles to the comparator to evaluate asking price, deal score, anomaly risk score, and full technical specifications side by side.

3.title: 4. Saved Filters, Risk Reports & Favorite Listings
3.description: Save custom search filters, historical risk assessments (with one-click Reanalyze against fresh market data), comparisons, and favorite cars in your account.
